Your stuff not lighting up is NOT, I repeat, it is NOT a hard drive problem, because it literally cannot be the hard drive (Does the hard drive power your GPU, mouse and keyboard? No, thus it does not have an effect on any of those).

If your system does not run bare (One RAM stick, no GPU) then this is a power supply or motherboard problem. If you have a spare mobo, and the power supply holds up on it and it powers everything, then your mobo is dead.

THIS IS NOT A HARD DRIVE PROBLEM.
